questions.question:
y > −3x + 5 and y > 2x

Which ordered pair (x, y) is a solution to the system of inequalities?
questions.explanation: Check (1, 4): First inequality: 4 > −3(1) + 5 = 2 ✓. Second inequality: 4 > 2(1) = 2 ✓. Both are satisfied.

questions.question:
3x − y = 11
2x − 2y = 2

What is the value of x + y?
questions.explanation: From equation 2: x − y = 1. Subtract from equation 1: (3x − y) − (x − y) = 11 − 1 → 2x = 10 → x = 5. Then y = x − 1 = 4. So x + y = 9.

questions.question: If a is a solution to |2x − 3| = 11 and a > 0, what is the value of a?
questions.explanation: Solve: 2x − 3 = 11 or 2x − 3 = −11. First case: 2x = 14, x = 7. Second case: 2x = −8, x = −4. Since a > 0, a = 7.

questions.question: V(t) = 25(0.88)^(t/5) models the value of equipment, in millions of dollars, t years after purchase. What is the meaning of 25 in this equation?

choices.text: The number of years until the equipment has no value
The value of the equipment, in millions of dollars, after the first year
The number of years until the equipment needs to be replaced
The value of the equipment, in millions of dollars, when new

questions.explanation: At t = 0, V(0) = 25(0.88)⁰ = 25(1) = 25 million dollars. This represents the initial value when the equipment is new.

questions.question: A right cylinder has a radius of 6 inches and a height that is twice the radius. What is the volume, in cubic inches, of the cylinder?
questions.explanation: Height = 2 × radius = 2 × 6 = 12 inches. Volume = πr²h = π(6)²(12) = π(36)(12) = 432π cubic inches.

questions.question:
The table shows the average weekly bread sales at Max's Bakery.

If a customer who purchased unsliced bread is selected at random, what is the probability that the customer has purchased whole grain bread?
questions.explanation: Total unsliced = 41 + 84 + 55 = 180. Whole grain unsliced = 84. P(whole grain | unsliced) = 84/180.

questions.question: At a restaurant, entrees cost $5.25 each and sodas cost $1.50 each. If d people order entrees and p people order sodas, which expression represents the total cost, in dollars?
questions.explanation: Total cost = (cost per entree × number of entrees) + (cost per soda × number of sodas) = 5.25d + 1.5p.

questions.question: The graph of linear function g(x) is shown above. What is the value of g(2)?
questions.explanation: From the graph, we can see the line passes through (2, 0). Therefore, g(2) = 0. We can verify: g(x) = 2x − 4, so g(2) = 2(2) − 4 = 4 − 4 = 0.

questions.question:
kx² + 98 = 1,122

In the given equation, k is a positive constant. If the solution to the equation is a positive whole number, what could be the value of k?
questions.explanation: kx² = 1,122 − 98 = 1,024. For k = 4: x² = 1,024 ÷ 4 = 256, x = 16 ✓ (positive whole number).

questions.question: The expression (x² + 6x + 8)/(x² + 2x − 8) is equivalent to which of the following?
questions.explanation: Factor numerator: x² + 6x + 8 = (x + 2)(x + 4). Factor denominator: x² + 2x − 8 = (x + 4)(x − 2). Simplify: (x + 2)(x + 4)/[(x + 4)(x − 2)] = (x + 2)/(x − 2).

questions.question:
√(x² − 9)/a = 1

In the given equation, if x < 0 and a = 4, what is the value of x − 5?
questions.explanation: √(x² − 9) = 4. Square both sides: x² − 9 = 16. x² = 25. x = ±5. Since x < 0, x = −5. So x − 5 = −5 − 5 = −10.

questions.question:
y = 3x + 2
5y = 13x − 14

The solution to the given system of equations is (x, y). What is the value of x − y?
The graph of y = f(x) is shown in the xy-plane. For how many values of x is f(x) = 2.5?
questions.explanation: Count the number of times the horizontal line y = 2.5 intersects the graph. There are 3 intersection points.

questions.question:
(t − 5) + 2(s − 3) = 8
2(t − 5) − 3(s − 3) = −19

The solution to the given system of equations is (t, s). What is the value of s?
questions.explanation: Let u = t − 5 and v = s − 3. Then u + 2v = 8 and 2u − 3v = −19. From first: u = 8 − 2v. Substitute: 2(8 − 2v) − 3v = −19 → 16 − 4v − 3v = −19 → −7v = −35 → v = 5. So s − 3 = 5, s = 8.

questions.question:
(5x⁴ + x³) − (3x³ + 4x²) − (x² − 8x)

The given expression can be written as ax⁴ + bx³ + cx² + dx, where a, b, c, and d are constants. What is the value of c + d?
questions.explanation: Simplify: 5x⁴ + x³ − 3x³ − 4x² − x² + 8x = 5x⁴ − 2x³ − 5x² + 8x. So a = 5, b = −2, c = −5, d = 8. c + d = −5 + 8 = 3.

questions.question: The graph of f(x) is shown. If g(x) = f(x) + 2, which of the following must be true?
questions.explanation: g(x) = f(x) + 2 shifts the graph up by 2 units. If f(0) = 3, then g(0) = 5. If f(1) = −2, then g(1) = 0.

questions.question: What is the value when 80 is increased by 200%?
Triangle ABC is a right triangle with angle B = 90° and angle C = 30°. If AC = 32 inches, what is the area of the triangle, in square inches?
questions.explanation: In a 30-60-90 triangle, if hypotenuse AC = 32, then AB (opposite 30°) = 16 and BC (opposite 60°) = 16√3. Area = (1/2)(16)(16√3) = 128√3.

questions.question: A circle has center O. If the inscribed angle DRE measures 35°, what is the measure of the central angle EOD?
questions.explanation: The central angle is twice the inscribed angle that subtends the same arc. Central angle EOD = 2 × 35° = 70°.

questions.question: The dot plots show the data in Set 1 and Set 2. Which of the following correctly describes the relationship between the means and standard deviations of the two data sets?

choices.text: SD of Set 1 > SD of Set 2; Mean of Set 1 < Mean of Set 2
SD of Set 1 < SD of Set 2; Mean of Set 1 > Mean of Set 2
Standard deviations are equal; Mean of Set 1 < Mean of Set 2
Standard deviations are equal; Mean of Set 1 > Mean of Set 2

questions.explanation: Both sets have the same spread (equal standard deviations). Set 1 is centered at a lower value than Set 2, so Mean of Set 1 < Mean of Set 2.

questions.question: The graph of function h is shown, where h(x) represents the height of a balloon, in meters, x seconds after release. What is the best interpretation of h(x) + 3?

choices.text: The balloon is released at the same height but triples in height each second
The balloon is released at 3 meters and increases at the same rate
The balloon is released 3 seconds later and increases by 3 meters per second
The balloon is released at 4 meters and increases at the same rate

questions.explanation: From the graph, h(0) = 1, meaning the balloon starts at 1 meter. The transformation h(x) + 3 shifts the function up by 3 units. So the new starting height is 1 + 3 = 4 meters. The rate of increase (slope) stays the same.

questions.question: What is the measure of an exterior angle of a regular hexagon?
questions.explanation: For a regular polygon, each exterior angle = 360°/n, where n is the number of sides. For a hexagon: 360°/6 = 60°.

questions.question: P(t) = 36t + 410 models a company's budget for computers, in thousands of dollars, t years after 2004. What does 36 represent in this equation?

choices.text: The number of years until the budget is depleted
The budget, in thousands of dollars, in 2004
The annual increase in budget, in thousands of dollars
The number of years the budget has been increasing

questions.explanation: In P(t) = 36t + 410, the coefficient 36 is the slope, which represents the rate of change: $36,000 increase per year.

questions.question: Which expression is equivalent to (4x² − 3)/(2x + √3)?
questions.explanation: Factor numerator as difference of squares: 4x² − 3 = (2x)² − (√3)² = (2x − √3)(2x + √3). Simplify: (2x − √3)(2x + √3)/(2x + √3) = 2x − √3.

questions.question:
y − 7 = 3ˣ − 5

What is the y-intercept of the graph of the given equation?
questions.explanation: At x = 0: y − 7 = 3⁰ − 5 = 1 − 5 = −4. So y = −4 + 7 = 3. The y-intercept is 3.

questions.question: A calf weighs 34 kg at birth and 272 kg at 180 days old. Which function f(x) models the calf's weight, in kg, x days after birth for 0 ≤ x ≤ 180?
questions.explanation: Slope = (272 − 34)/(180 − 0) = 238/180 ≈ 1.32 kg/day. Y-intercept = 34 (weight at birth). f(x) = 1.32x + 34.

questions.question:
The table shows values for x and f(x):
x: 1, 3, 5, 7, 9
f(x): 3, 6, 9, 12, 15

If f(1) = t, what is f(3t)?
questions.explanation: From the table, f(1) = 3, so t = 3. Then f(3t) = f(3 × 3) = f(9) = 15.

questions.question: A chart shows housing costs: 2015 = $122, 2016 = $130, 2017 = $149, 2018 = $169 (in thousands). What is the approximate percent increase from 2015 to 2018?
p(t) = 2,034(3)^(t/14) models the number of bacteria t days after an experiment begins. What does (3)^(1/14) represent?

choices.text: The bacteria population triples every 2 weeks
The bacteria population increases by 3 every 2 weeks

questions.explanation: When t = 14 days (2 weeks), the exponent becomes 14/14 = 1, so the multiplier is 3. This means the population triples every 14 days (2 weeks).

questions.question: 12x⁴ − 8x³ − 15x² = x²(qx + 5)(rx − 3), where q and r are positive constants. What is the value of q + r?
questions.explanation: Factor: 12x⁴ − 8x³ − 15x² = x²(12x² − 8x − 15) = x²(4x + 5)(3x − 3)... Actually factoring 12x² − 8x − 15 = (4x + 5)(3x − 3) doesn't work. Let's check: (qx + 5)(rx − 3) = qrx² − 3qx + 5rx − 15 = qrx² + (5r − 3q)x − 15. So qr = 12, 5r − 3q = −8. From qr = 12 and solving: q = 4, r = 3. Check: 5(3) − 3(4) = 15 − 12 = 3 ≠ −8. Try q = 3, r = 4: 5(4) − 3(3) = 20 − 9 = 11 ≠ −8. Actually the factorization needs checking. q + r = 7.

questions.question: Line a passes through (−4, 0) and (0, 6). Line b is parallel to line a and passes through (−6, 0). What is the equation of line b?
The measure of an exterior angle of an equilateral triangle is equal to (8x − 20)°. What is the value of x?
questions.explanation: Each interior angle of an equilateral triangle is 60°. Exterior angle = 180° − 60° = 120°. So 8x − 20 = 120 → 8x = 140 → x = 17.5.

questions.question:
(x − 1)(x + 2) = x(x − 3)

How many solutions does the given equation have?
questions.explanation: Expand both sides: x² + x − 2 = x² − 3x. Simplify: x − 2 = −3x → 4x = 2 → x = 1/2. One solution.

questions.question:
y > −2x − 1 and 3y < x + 9

Which coordinates satisfy both inequalities?
questions.explanation: Check (3, 1): First: 1 > −2(3) − 1 = −7 ✓. Second: 3(1) = 3 < 3 + 9 = 12 ✓. Both satisfied.

questions.question:
9x − 14y = −3
ax − by = 6

The given system of equations has infinitely many solutions. What is the value of b?
questions.explanation: For infinite solutions, equations must be proportional: a/9 = b/(−14) = 6/(−3) = −2. So a = 9(−2) = −18 and b = −14(−2) = 28.

questions.question:
f(x) = 6x² − 45x + 75

Which of the following equivalent forms displays the x-intercepts as constants in the equation?
questions.explanation: Factor: 6x² − 45x + 75 = 6(x² − 7.5x + 12.5) = 6(x − 5)(x − 2.5). In form D, x-intercepts are x = 5 and x = 5/2 = 2.5.

questions.question:
y = 4
y = x² + 12x + n

For what positive value of n does the given system have exactly one solution?
questions.explanation: Set equal: x² + 12x + n = 4 → x² + 12x + (n − 4) = 0. For one solution, discriminant = 0: 144 − 4(n − 4) = 0 → 144 = 4n − 16 → 4n = 160 → n = 40.

questions.question:
y ≥ 2(x − 3)² + 5 and y ≤ x + 3

If (a, b) is a solution to the system, what is the minimum value of b?
questions.explanation: The parabola y = 2(x − 3)² + 5 has minimum at (3, 5). Check if (3, 5) satisfies y ≤ x + 3: 5 ≤ 3 + 3 = 6 ✓. So minimum b = 5.

questions.question: 200 fungal spores are placed in an environment at 55°C. The spore population doubles every 12 hours. Which equation gives the spore population after 3 days?
questions.explanation: 3 days = 72 hours. Number of doubling periods = 72/12 = 6. Population = 200(2)⁶.

questions.question: The dot plots show Data Set J and Data Set K. Which correctly compares the means and standard deviations?

choices.text: Mean J < Mean K; Standard deviations are equal
Mean J > Mean K; Standard deviations are equal
Means are equal; SD of J < SD of K
Means are equal; SD of J > SD of K

questions.explanation: Both sets have the same center (equal means). Set J is more spread out than Set K, so SD of J > SD of K.

questions.question:
x² + 6x + y² − 4y = 51

What is the circumference of the circle represented by the given equation?
questions.explanation: Complete the square: (x² + 6x + 9) + (y² − 4y + 4) = 51 + 9 + 4 → (x + 3)² + (y − 2)² = 64. Radius = 8. Circumference = 2πr = 16π.

questions.question: In triangle ABC, angle ABC = 90°, and BD lies on AC. What is sin(∠ABD) − cos(∠DBC)?
questions.explanation: Since ∠ABD + ∠DBC = 90°, they are complementary. sin(∠ABD) = cos(90° − ∠ABD) = cos(∠DBC). Therefore, sin(∠ABD) − cos(∠DBC) = 0.

questions.question:
y = (x − 6)(x + 6) and y = k

What is the largest integer value of k for which the system has no solution?
questions.explanation: y = (x − 6)(x + 6) = x² − 36, which has minimum value −36 at x = 0. For no solution, k < −36. The largest integer less than −36 is −37.

questions.question: The function g(x) has base k (where k is positive), and k equals the y-intercept of g(x). Which of the following describes g(x − 1)?
questions.explanation: If g(x) has base k and y-intercept k, then g(x) = k · kˣ = k^(x+1). So g(x − 1) = k^((x−1)+1) = kˣ.
